intro: From April 13 to July 21, 2026, ZCyberNews published 17 articles covering the tag rapid7. The reporting highlighted activity from threat actors ClickFix, KongTuke, and Kyber, and tracked critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-20127 and CVE-2026-20182, both with a CVSS score of 10, alongside CVE-2025-59718 and CVE-2026-41940 at 9.8, and CVE-2023-30253. Affected sectors spanned financial services, government, technology, cybersecurity, and enterprise, with a global impact across Europe and North America. The coverage comprised four high-severity, four critical, and five informational items.
